#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exponent) {
    if (exponent <= 0LL) {
        return 1LL;
    }
    long long half = pow_mod(base * base % MOD, exponent / 2LL);
    if (exponent & 1LL) {
        return half * base % MOD;
    }
    return half;
}

int main() {
    long long N, M, L, R;
    cin >> N >> M >> L >> R;
    
    long long cells = N * M;
    long long range = R - L + 1;
    long long powered = pow_mod(range, cells);
    
    if (cells % 2LL == 1LL) {
        cout << powered << endl;
    } else if (range % 2LL == 0LL) {
        cout << (powered * ((MOD + 1LL) / 2LL) % MOD) << endl;
    } else {
        cout << ((powered + 1LL) * ((MOD + 1LL) / 2LL) % MOD) << endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
